header.name: NIKHIL GANPAT NAVGHADE
header.title: Senior Field Application Engineer | Automotive Radar | Radar SoCs | System Integration

summary: Senior Field Application / Radar Engineer with 12+ years of experience across automotive radar, radar SoCs, signal processing, embedded systems, system integration, validation and technical customer support. Combines deep radar algorithm knowledge with hands-on system debugging, RF validation and automation. Experienced in bridging application needs with engineering teams, troubleshooting HW/SW issues, supporting radar SoC integration, and translating complex radar-system behavior into actionable technical solutions.
competencies: Field Application Engineering: Radar SoCs, system bring-up, technical troubleshooting, customer/application support
Radar Systems: Automotive FMCW radar, radar signal chain, MIMO/DOA, detection, angle processing, radar performance
System Integration & Validation: HW/SW integration, RF validation, automated testing, regression, root-cause analysis
Radar Algorithms & DSP: Range/Doppler/angle processing, FFT, CFAR, beamforming, sidelobe suppression, noise estimation
Automation & Software: Python, MATLAB, Embedded C, C, machine learning, edge AI, validation orchestration and data analysis
RF / Lab Engineering: Radar evaluation boards, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, oscilloscopes, power supplies, power meters
Architecture & Technical Leadership: Radar processing chains, software/module architecture, multi-core systems, memory optimization
Technical Communication: Cross-functional engineering, customer issue analysis, workshops, demonstrations and R&D coordination

bullets: Develop automated system-level validation for automotive radar using an internal framework based mainly on Python, integrated with MATLAB and Java.
Build validation workflows spanning radar configurations, temperature, power cycling, instrument settings and repeated execution, including runs with thousands of iterations.
Use MATLAB for signal processing, measurement analysis, validation logic and plotting; use Java integration for radar-board and laboratory-instrument automation.
Automate RF/lab equipment including R&S SMA100B, R&S FSW85, RTA2064, Agilent 33250A, power meters and LAN-controlled power supplies, depending on the test setup.
Completed RX Filter Shaping validation and additional validation work covering Supply Ripple, Group/Chip-to-Chip Delay and Phase Rotation; currently working on Range-Doppler accuracy/separation.
Extend the validation environment with reusable instrument-control interfaces, automated pass/fail evaluation and CVDB (PostgreSQL) result reporting for traceability and analysis.

experience.role: Field Application Engineer / Radar System Engineer
bullets: Supported radar SoC application and system bring-up, debugging issues across acquisition, calibration, detection and angle-estimation functions.
Investigated HW/SW integration problems and supported resolution of customer-reported radar-system issues across the processing pipeline and SoC features.
Bridged application needs and China-based R&D, translating field feedback and technical requirements into engineering discussions and product actions.
Delivered hands-on technical support, workshops and product demonstrations, including radar SoC demonstration at Electronica 2024.
Worked on SoC/system topics including Secure Boot, OTP, Ethernet, Functional Safety and cybersecurity.

experience.role: Senior Radar Signal Processing Engineer / Radar Expert
bullets: Architected and developed radar signal-processing chains in MATLAB covering range, Doppler and angle processing, with MIMO and beamforming.
Worked across radar algorithm architecture, software architecture, memory mapping, memory optimization, multi-core architecture, module integration and system debugging.
Developed antenna/radar analysis tools for beam patterns, sidelobes and virtual-array evaluation, reducing analysis effort from approximately one week to one day.
Contributed to development of a first 4×4 corner-radar prototype and subsequent 6×8 front-radar development; provided technical direction and module-level leadership.
Developed radar signal-processing and algorithm modules for automotive FMCW radar systems.
Implemented CFAR, elevation MIMO, sidelobe suppression and noise-estimation functions and supported system-level optimization.
Developed radar processing modules across ARM Cortex-M, DSP and MATLAB environments with runtime/memory optimization and root-cause analysis.
Contributed to production radar validation; reported functional coverage of 99.92% for a Gen5 radar validation activity.
Developed embedded firmware and DSP software for pulse / wind-profiler radar systems.
Participated in radar development, debugging and product-lifecycle activities.

selected_nxp_experience: Supply Ripple Validation: automated RX/TX characterization using controlled ripple injection, ADC/Range-FFT analysis, spectrum-analyzer sideband measurements, automated pass/fail decisions and database reporting.
Group / Chip-to-Chip Delay: synchronized ADC acquisition, FFT without windowing, frequency-domain cross-correlation, chirp averaging, phase extraction/unwrapping and linear phase fitting.
Phase Rotation: fine chirp-to-chirp phase-step validation and INL/DNL-style step-error evaluation against defined limits.
Validation Architecture: requirement-derived Excel inputs, layered orchestration, instrument-control interfaces, signal-processing analysis, regression execution and CVDB traceability.
